messages:
marta: Hey team — ACME Retail wants a short POC this Thurs-Fri. They need a Dedicated pool with ephemeral capacity to handle a 2-hour demo spike. Can we allocate an elastic reserve window and provide temp API keys? Details: region us-west-2, target p95 tokens/s ~800, expected concurrent sessions ~30. Prefer autoscale + burst credits for a 2h window. Also need pricing estimate for the uplift and confirmation on IP allowlist for their VPC.

jordan: We can do an ephemeral reserved pool. Two options: create a temporary dedicated pool (recommended) or increase burst credits on the existing pool. Which should we pursue? :thinking_face:

marta: Temporary dedicated pool please — sales wants a nonblocking path that won't disturb other customers. If possible make it self-contained and time-limited.

kai: For temp pool I'll propose config:
- gpu_type: a10g
- min_replicas: 1
- max_replicas: 8
- burst_credits: 12000
- autoscale_policy: aggressive
I'll patch the infra once approved. ETA ~90m.

sam: Pricing (rough): base reserved hourly + per-GPU-hour + burst surcharge. For a 2h window with 8 a10g GPUs it's approx $X00/hr total (I'll send a line-item). We can also issue a time-limited API token scoped to the pool (TTL 6h) for dev/devops. Tokens will be tagged for billing.

marta: Please share exact pricing numbers and the token creds for the integration engineering team. Also send the steps for IP allowlist so customer can prep their VPC egress.

kai: To provision we run these runbook commands:
```
redwoodctl pools create --name acme-poc-temp --region us-west-2 --gpu a10g --min 1 --max 8 --burst-credits 12000 --autoscale aggressive --ttl 6h
redwoodctl tokens create --scope pool:acme-poc-temp --ttl 6h --note "sales POC demo"
```
(Will run after approval and CIDR blocks received.)

jordan: I'll coordinate schedule with the customer. Marta — send me their allowed CIDR blocks. @deploy-bot schedule at 2026-03-25T15:00Z

deploy-bot: scheduled job j-4421 to create pool acme-poc-temp at 2026-03-25T15:00Z

kai: Note — we'll enable graceful fallback to hosted model if the pool can't scale in time. Fallback policy: fallback_model=gpt-small-1 so demo stays responsive.

marta: One more — will this produce separate billing lines for finance? Sales needs a tagged invoice.

sam: Yes — we will tag all usage with sales:acme-poc and send a dedicated line-item. I'll DM the spreadsheet with exact numbers.

jordan: All set on my end. I'll post creds once the pool is provisioned. :thumbsup:
